subpackages.description: Library files for %(name), typically pulled in as a dependency of another package.

jay.install:
%cargo_install

%install_file etc/jay.portal %(installroot)%(datadir)/xdg-desktop-portal/portals/jay.portal
%install_file etc/jay-portals.conf %(installroot)%(datadir)/xdg-desktop-portal/jay-portals.conf
%install_file etc/jay.desktop %(installroot)%(datadir)/wayland-sessions/jay.desktop

%(installroot)%(bindir)/jay generate-completion bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/jay
%(installroot)%(bindir)/jay generate-completion fish | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/jay.fish
%(installroot)%(bindir)/jay generate-completion zsh | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_jay

# TODO: When we support setting capabilities make sure to add CAP_SYS_NICE to the jay binary

jbigkit.install:
%install_file libjbig/*.h -t %(installroot)%(includedir)
%install_exe libjbig/*.so.* -t %(installroot)%(libdir)

for lib in libjbig.so libjbig85.so; do
    ln -sv "$lib.%(version)" %(installroot)%(libdir)/$lib
done

%install_exe pbmtools/{jbgtopbm{,85},pbmtojbg{,85}} -t %(installroot)%(bindir)
%install_file pbmtools/*.1* -t %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/

jemalloc.setup:
# Note: We need static libjemalloc for rust
%configure \
    --disable-fill

jpegxl.setup:
rm -rf third_party/{sjpeg,skcms}
ln -s ../../sjpeg.git third_party/sjpeg
ln -s ../../skcms.git third_party/skcms

%cmake \
    -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
    -DJPEGXL_ENABLE_BENCHMARK=OFF \
    -DJPEGXL_ENABLE_PLUGINS=ON \
    -DJPEGXL_ENABLE_PLUGIN_MIME=ON \
    -DJPEGXL_ENABLE_PLUGIN_GDKPIXBUF=OFF
jpegxl.install:
%cmake_install

# This is obviously not ABI compatible but _boulder doesn't know that_
for i in libjxl libjxl_cms libjxl_threads; do
    cp %(installroot)%(libdir)/${i}.so.0.13 %(installroot)%(libdir)/${i}.so.0.12
    cp %(installroot)%(libdir)/${i}.so.0.13.0 %(installroot)%(libdir)/${i}.so.0.12.0
    patchelf --set-soname ${i}.so.0.12 %(installroot)%(libdir)/${i}.so.0.12.0
done

%install_dir %(installroot)%(docdir)/jxl-pixbuf-loader
echo "DEPRECATED" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/jxl-pixbuf-loader/README

subpackages.description: Library files for JPEG-XL - Development headers
JPEG-XL image loader for GTK+ applications
Utilities for manipulating JPEG XL images

jq.setup:
# Note that autoconf (reconfigure/autoconf macros) breaks the version script (breaking `jq --version` and the version string in the pkgconfig)
%configure \
    --disable-static

jsoncpp.build:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat
        %ccache_zero
        env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %meson_build
        %ccache_stats
    popd
fi

%ccache_zero
env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %meson_build
%ccache_stats
jsoncpp.install:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat/
    mkdir tmp
    DESTDIR="${PWD}/tmp" meson install --no-rebuild -C "%(builddir)"

    # Only copy the sonames
    %install_dir %(installroot)/%(libdir)
    find ${PWD}/tmp/%(libdir) -name "libjsoncpp.so.*" -print -exec mv {} %(installroot)/%(libdir) \;
    popd
fi

%meson_install

# Breaks OpenXR build
# https://github.com/open-source-parsers/jsoncpp/issues/1568
rm -rf %(installroot)%(libdir)/cmake

jujutsu.install:
%cargo_install jj

%(cargo_target_dir)/jj util completion bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/jj
%(cargo_target_dir)/jj util completion zsh | tail -n+3 | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_jj
# Don't install fish completions as the fish package ships a superior version

%(cargo_target_dir)/jj util install-man-pages %(installroot)%(mandir)
